Senior Software Engineer, Routing (Go)
Courierly · Remote · Full time
Apply now
Save job
Share

FICTIONAL job post for tests.

About Courierly

Courierly runs same-day delivery for 1,800 independent shops in 12 cities. Every morning our routing engine plans thousands of stops across bikes and vans.

About the role

We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join the routing team. You will work on the services that quote delivery prices, assign drivers and replan routes when traffic changes.

What you will do
• Build and scale routing and pricing services in Go
• Design APIs (gRPC internally, REST for partners)
• Work with PostgreSQL and PostGIS for geospatial queries
• Publish and consume events with Kafka
• Keep p99 latency low under peak load; profile and optimize
• Mentor engineers and take part in architecture reviews

What we are looking for
• 5+ years of backend experience, 2+ in Go
• Strong PostgreSQL skills
• Experience with event-driven architectures and Kafka
• Experience with Docker and Kubernetes
• Nice to have: PostGIS, routing or logistics domain experience, Redis

Benefits
• Remote-first, work from anywhere between UTC and UTC+8
• Salary range 75,000 to 100,000 USD
